item.IPA_transcription: Á bàrà ná bwòl hòm tàŋ̈à ɡ͡bóf hòm .
item.gloss: He remembers my leg and my cheek.
He pushed the screen with a stick.

item.IPA_transcription: Mé ré nàmà ká jè ɲàmà .
item.gloss: I eat meat of every animal.

item.IPA_transcription: Bà nóŋ hwà hwòm hyén nà yòs hwýeɡèlèk .
item.gloss: My wife was given an orphan yesterday evening.

item.IPA_transcription: I wa de a lasak vʷara ɡomó na vara vere-e ?
item.gloss: Who spoilt this wall and those walls?
